text.tspan: Actual dimensions, string data and load-path review required before fabrication or tensioning.
Shell outline is symbolic; actual profile is unmeasured.
17 sheets. One traceable Rev B set.
Elevations, sections, part interfaces, force diagrams, candidate string calculations, and field records. This issue expands
the drawing detail and corrects the supplied PDF calculations; it records no fabricated or tested assembly.
Anchor bar pattern and bending axes
All dimensions retain their status. N values are planning dimensions, C values depend on written assumptions, and U values
require measurement, selection or calculation. Blank fields mean unresolved.
The primary string load path is the frame and its joints. The vessel has independent padded support. No certified capacity, final
hole schedule, deflection result or acoustic performance is established by this set.
